tasksui.title: Tasks
tasksui.subtitle: Cards copied for the model, closed only by evidence from a re-run or by your decision.
tasksui.expectedOwner: The owner sets the expected result before the test is written.
tasksui.modelNote: This whole text is what will be copied, shown as in the «for the model» report.
tasksui.closeReasonHint: For example: intended behavior, or no longer needed.
tasksui.empty: No cards yet. Cards are made from the results, the advisor and the model checks.
tasksui.pick: Choose a card to see its details.
tasksui.advisor.title: Suggest checks for a change
tasksui.advisor.intro: Describe the change with what you know. Every input is optional, and «I don’t know» widens the suggestion instead of guessing. The advisor suggests checks and cards with their reasons, and judges no result.
tasksui.advisor.footer: The advisor sends nothing anywhere: it applies local knowledge rules to your answers and the project’s facts.
tasksui.out.title: Suggestions for a change: {situation}
tasksui.out.subtitle: From your answers and the project’s facts. Suggestions with their reasons; results come from a run, not from the advisor.
tasksui.out.rangeNote: A range, not one level, because {questions} has no answer.
tasksui.out.created: {count, plural, one {# card was created} other {# cards were created}} in Tasks.
tasksui.out.noNewTests: No new test is needed for this change; a suggestion, never a skip.
tasksui.closesBy: It becomes «verified» when a re-run in AYAR proves it: {checks}, with no integrity effect on it.
tasksui.closesByDecision: No AYAR check proves it; it closes by your decision.
